Integrations.title: Integrations
Integrations.intro: Connect the Google Drive that holds your content, media, uploads, reports and backups.
Integrations.fakeDriver: Development mode: the app is using a local sample folder instead of Google Drive (STORAGE_DRIVER=fake).
Integrations.driveHelp: Your Drive stays yours: the app keeps only an encrypted access key and reads/writes inside the LinguaPath folder.

Integrations.setupIntro: Do this once in Google Cloud with the Google account that owns your Drive, then add the two values to the app's settings.

setup.s1: Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project (any name, e.g. LinguaPath).
setup.s2: APIs & Services → Library: enable “Google Drive API” and “Google Sheets API”.
setup.s3: OAuth consent screen: choose External, fill in the app name and your email.
setup.s4: On the same screen press “Publish app” so it is “In production” (otherwise the connection expires every 7 days).
setup.s5: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application.
setup.s7: Copy the Client ID and Client secret into the app settings as GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables), redeploy, then come back here and press Connect.

aiCheck.off: Switched off. In Vercel, AI_ENABLED is not set to true for Production (or the site was not redeployed after setting it).
aiCheck.noKey: No key. In Vercel, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing for Production (or the site was not redeployed after adding it).
aiCheck.badKey: The key was refused (error {status}). Copy the key again from console.anthropic.com → API Keys, replace ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Vercel, then redeploy.
aiCheck.noCredit: No credit (error {status}). Add credit in console.anthropic.com → Billing. It can take a few minutes to start working.
aiCheck.denied: The key is not allowed to use the AI reader (error {status}). Check the key's workspace in console.anthropic.com.
aiCheck.noModel: The model {model} is not available to your account (error {status}). Ask Claude Code which AI_MODEL to set.
aiCheck.busy: The AI service is busy or limited right now (error {status}). Try again in a minute.
aiCheck.unreachable: The site could not reach the AI service. Try again in a minute.
aiCheck.failed: The AI reader did not work (error {status}). Tell Claude Code this number.
